    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Appointment
    Stores the pet, veterinarian, time, and notes for an appointment.
    AppointmentConflictException
    Reports that a veterinarian is already booked at a requested time.
    Cat
    Represents a cat and whether it is an indoor cat.
    Clinic
    Manages clinic data in memory and saves changes to the database.
    ClinicCLI
    Provides the command-line menus for managing the clinic.
    DailyAppointmentLimitException
    Reports that a veterinarian has reached the daily appointment limit.
    DatabaseManager
    Loads and changes PostgreSQL clinic data using JDBC.
    Dog
    Represents a dog and its vaccination status.
    Identifiable
    Defines an object that has a database ID.
    Main
    Starts the Paws & Care Veterinary Clinic program.
    Owner
    Stores an owner's contact information and registered pets.
    Pet
    Stores information shared by dogs and cats.
    Receptionist
    Represents a clinic receptionist.
    Staff
    Stores information shared by veterinarians and receptionists.
    Veterinarian
    Represents a veterinarian and their area of expertise.
